properties.title: Romania summons Russia’s ambassador after downing third drone since Friday
properties.summary: F-16 fighter jet intercepted drone in Romanian airspace over Black Sea, defence minister says Romania has said it is summoning Russia’s ambassador after the Nato member’s military shot down a third drone in as many days. Romania has experienced frequent drone incursions since Russia launched its 2022 invasion of Ukraine, but had not shot down any until Friday. Continue reading...

Sunday’s incident marked the latest escalation for the NATO member. properties.title: Beethoven versus birds: ECB shortlists designs for new euro banknotes
